description: Guest functions with a hand-written native override (tools/oot3d/native_game_runtime/oot3d_native_guest_overrides.cpp), wired into the generated C++ by apply_guest_overrides.py. They only go here after passing run_guest_override_equivalence.py with no difference at all. Samples: Kokiri block profile (profiles/navi_kokiri_main_forest_source_coverage.json); switch_share = fraction of guest time in the console profile (comparacao/2026-10-16-pgo1, logs-final-pgo/guest_profile.txt). Items with 'function' are block overrides: the prologue goes at the block_<entry> label of function 'function' and the native version resumes at one of the PCs in 'resume'. 'inline': single-line prologue, without shifting the shard's lines (preserves PGO of the shard's other functions). 'disabled': reason; the item is not wired into the generated C++, but stays in the differential test (run_guest_override_equivalence.py). kokiri_real_us_per_frame: estimated real cost in the 2026-10-17 profile (time minus ~180 ns of overhead per block entry, per measured frame).
